headline: NXP lists an AI-agent internship for migrating behavioral models and generating validation testbenches
fact: NXP posted Toulouse internship R-10066989 on September 23 for AI-agent behavioral-model migration and mixed-signal stimuli/testbench generation, using Verilog/SystemVerilog and Verilog-AMS. Evaluation covers code quality, test-scenario coverage, automation rate, time savings and robustness, with regression checks and documented limitations. October 5 role R-10067009 covers AI-generated HDL AMS models and an oscillator/ADC/supply Golden Library. Related October 6 Design Enablement role R-10067212 assigns Python agents, LLM/RAG and surrogate-model generation, verification and qualification; its model language is unspecified. These grouped research advertisements propose evaluation work rather than demonstrate successful deployment.

sources.title: NXP Careers: Stage Ingénieur : Génération semi-automatique de modèles, stimuli et testbenches par agents IA (F/H) (R-10066989)
sources.summary: Official Workday startDate remains September 23, 2026. Full proposed evaluation includes automation rate, code quality, scenario coverage, time savings, robustness, regression detection and limitations. These are project metrics to establish, not achieved gains.

sources.title: NXP Careers: AMS model generation and maintenance internship (R-10067009)
sources.summary: Official Workday startDate is October 5, 2026. The related role describes HDL AMS model generation/maintenance and an oscillator/ADC/supply Golden Library; this later posting does not change the first role’s September 23 date.

sources.title: NXP Careers: AI-driven behavioral-model generation and qualification (R-10067212)
sources.summary: Official Workday startDate is October 6, 2026. Full Design Enablement duties cover Python AI agents, LLM/RAG and prototype evaluation for surrogate behavioral-model generation/verification/qualification. Analog electronics is required; no particular HDL or circuit block is specified.
